summary.text: Stephanie Mickelsen represents Idaho House District 32, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Idaho Falls as the legislator's city.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Mickelsen was born in Idaho Falls, graduated from Blackfoot High School, and holds an associate degree in economics from BYU-Idaho.
It describes Mickelsen as a potato farmer, former Idaho Farm Bureau state director and former College of Eastern Idaho trustee.

sources.title: Idaho House of Representatives membership directory (2026 session)
